records.name: sortablejs
records.review: Sortable code contains no scanned network/eval/storage/cookie APIs. axe has built-in CSS/media XHR preload and internal Function/template/configuration utilities; integration disables preload and caller customization. No downloaded build/install scripts run. Browser request and CSP checks required.
